I did not find evidence of an actual 2024 term-limit breach or refusal to transfer office; the main negatives are indirect, coming from late-term reforms that critics said would weaken independent constraints rather than from any open succession crisis.","evidence":[{"title":"25-06-24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-06-25","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/","summary":"AMLO said he was finishing his cycle, that he supported no reelection, that he would leave office for Palenque, and that Sheinbaum was fully prepared to govern.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.5"]},{"title":"20-06-24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador","publisher":"Presidencia de México","date":"2024-06-20","url":"https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/20-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/","summary":"AMLO said a vote-by-vote recount was the best way to remove suspicion and that citizens should respect what the electoral authority decides.","question_ids":["4B.8","4B.1"]},{"title":"Tribunal Electoral valida elección presidencial: Segob;
